investigation_notes.Description: A PowerShell script was executed on the host WKSTN-SR-42 with a hidden window and an encoded command. The command was launched by powershell.exe and originated from a parent process cmd.exe, indicating potential obfuscation of the payload. The activity was performed by user Administrator from source IP 10.30.15.11, and encoded commands with hidden windows are commonly associated with malware deployment or data exfiltration attempts, so this is marked as high priority and requires further investigation.
